QuestInfo.name: [Presidential Election] Speaking Hall Preparation 1 (Stew)
QuestInfo.0: Stew, the Democratic donkey, needs your help.
QuestInfo.1: The Grays have taken over the Speaking Hall. Drive them out!
QuestInfo.2: Return to Stew now that you have chased out the Barnard Grays.

0.0: Hey! Y-ya gotta help me out. A bunch of crazy rightwing radical aliens showed up and started blasting off their ray guns! They're trying to repress our freedom. Can you help?

1.0: Did you get it? Did you bring our freedom back?

yes.0: One problem down, but we're on our way to having a debate!

mob.0: Oh, I'm sorry, I thought you cared about freedom!
